purpose: Post-hoc answer-path diagnostic after the preregistered retrieval arm; no training and no default change.

generation.prompt:
Answer the query from stored records when a record answers it. Reply with only the value. If no stored record answers it, reply UNKNOWN.

Query: {query}

budget: 12 greedy generations; one native model load; no optimizer update; no checkpoint save
retention: Preserve raw prompts, token IDs and answers; this is diagnostic, not a held-out retrieval arm.
claims: Distinguishes correct-slot, swapped-slot, no-slot and exact-text behavior; cannot establish broad generation quality.
